label: Security attestations
openQuestions: Specific Payroc security/PCI requirements to confirm with Payroc security

scenarios.title: No PAN or CVV in logs
scenarios.objective: Attest card data is never logged.
steps: Provide written attestation and a log/config excerpt.
scenarios.expected: Log samples show no PAN/CVV/full track data.

scenarios.title: API key and secrets server-side only
scenarios.objective: Attest keys never ship to browser/mobile.
steps: Provide written attestation and a log/config excerpt.
scenarios.expected: Keys read from env/secrets manager; none in client bundles or repo.

scenarios.title: Webhook secret protected
scenarios.objective: Attest webhook secret in secrets store and compared constant-time.
steps: Provide written attestation and a log/config excerpt.
scenarios.expected: Evidence of storage and comparison code.

scenarios.title: Tokens and Authorization headers redacted in logs
steps: Provide written attestation and a log/config excerpt.

scenarios.title: UAT ids and keys not in production config
steps: Provide written attestation and a log/config excerpt.
scenarios.expected: Prod config has no UAT ids, keys or hosts.

scenarios.title: Owner PII and bank data protected
scenarios.objective: Attest SSN/bank details not logged and minimally stored.
steps: Provide written attestation and a log/config excerpt.
